reasoning_content:
All 9 services are now Up (tileserver healthy, "Startup complete", /health 200).

Now, let's do a final comprehensive verification pass:
1. All services running ✓
2. API endpoint via Caddy ✓
3. Frontend via Caddy ✓
4. Admin ✓
5. QGIS ✓ (auth + correct WMS responses)
6. DB: migrations, extensions, superuser, qgis_user ✓
7. tileserver healthy ✓
8. WebDAV files.localhost — needs testing (forward_auth gate + webdav)
9. tiles.localhost — test via Caddy

Let's test tiles.localhost and files.localhost via Caddy, then wrap up.

Also, I should re-verify the git diff of the modified files, to make sure the changes are clean and to be able to summarize them accurately.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "echo "=== tiles.localhost (tilejson) ==="; curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://tiles.localhost/styles/light.json -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 "https://tiles.localhost/data/germany.json" -o /dev/null -w "tilejson: HTTP %{http_code}\n"
echo "=== files.localhost WebDAV (unauth -> forward_auth) ==="; curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://files.localhost/ -o /dev/null -w "unauth: HTTP %{http_code}\n"
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X POST https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin!LocalDev123"}' | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "=== files.localhost WebDAV PROPFIND (auth) ==="; curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -X PROPFIND -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://files.localhost/ -o /tmp/webdav.xml -w "auth PROPFIND: HTTP %{http_code}\n"; head -c 300 /tmp/webdav.xml", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
